roles.title: Data Analyst
highlights: Analyze customer, account, transaction and operational datasets of 120K+ records with SQL to find business trends, performance changes and reporting gaps.
Perform data validation, reconciliation and root-cause analysis across source systems and reporting outputs, helping reduce recurring data discrepancies by 21%.
Improve recurring SQL and BI reporting workflows by simplifying data preparation and report generation, reducing manual reporting effort by 28%.

roles.title: Data Analyst
highlights: Analyzed financial and investment datasets of 175K+ records, examining performance trends, reporting variances and data-quality exceptions.
Reconciled source-system data against reporting results, investigated mismatches and documented findings, helping reduce unresolved reporting discrepancies by 19%.
Standardized data preparation, validation and reconciliation procedures with business and technology teams, reducing manual analysis effort by 22%.

roles.title: Junior Data Analyst
highlights: Analyzed insurance policy, claims, customer and operational datasets of 85K+ records using SQL and Excel to find performance trends and data inconsistencies.
Cleaned, transformed and reconciled data from multiple sources, applying validation checks that improved reporting consistency by 16%.
Prepared recurring business reports and ad hoc analyses covering 9+ policy, claims, service and operational KPIs.
